import json, os
plan=json.load(open('.exp_agent/round_plan_01.json'))
rules=plan['rules']
selected=[r['rule'] for r in rules]
consulted={}
for r in rules:
    paths=[r['semantic_spec']['core_spec_path']]
    paths += [f['spec_path'] for f in r['semantic_spec']['families']]
    consulted[r['rule']]=paths
repairs=[]
for r in rules:
    rule=r['rule']
    for f in r['files']:
        path=f['relative_path']
        base=os.path.basename(path)
        if rule == '@performance/hp-arkui-no-state-var-access-in-loop':
            entity=f'for-loop router callback state handling in {base}'
            invariants=[
                'state ownership and UI read/write timing',
                'callback invocation timing and error propagation',
                'execution order across synchronous loop scheduling and asynchronous callbacks'
            ]
            evidence=[
                'The affected struct renders text1 and each frozen location is a direct asynchronous router callback assignment inside a loop.',
                'The callback forms, router options, error branches, and success logging remain unchanged; only the state write is delegated outside loop syntax.'
            ]
            transformation='Added a private setText1(value: string) method retaining the original text1 assignment and changed each callback to invoke it, preserving callback timing, error values, and UI ownership while removing direct state access from loop logic.'
        elif rule == '@performance/hp-arkui-remove-container-without-property':
            entity=f'layout container in {base}'
            invariants=[
                'layout width propagation and child placement',
                'hit testing and accessibility structure',
                'component and child preservation'
            ]
            evidence=[
                'The flagged Column directly contains one Text child and has no conditional content, padding, margin, clipping, alignment, or z-order modifiers.',
                'The surrounding page uses full-width page layouts; an explicit width of 100% preserves the existing intended width while keeping both container and child declarations.'
            ]
            transformation='Retained the original Column and Text nodes and added the explicit width(100%) modifier to the surviving container.'
        elif rule == '@performance/hp-arkui-avoid-empty-callback':
            entity=f'empty optional Button click listener in {base}'
            invariants=[
                'callback presence semantics for the Button API',
                'component and user-visible layout preservation'
            ]
            evidence=[
                'The frozen listener body is empty and no code, API flag, navigation, state mutation, or test depends on listener presence.',
                'The Button label, type, margin, background color, surrounding Flex, and component declaration remain unchanged.'
            ]
            transformation='Removed only the optional empty onClick listener from the existing Button; retained the Button and all visual/configuration properties.'
        elif rule == '@performance/hp-arkui-remove-redundant-state-var':
            entity=f'redundant state field(s) in {base}'
            invariants=[
                'state ownership and reactive update sources',
                'UI reads and parent-child data flow',
                'lifecycle mutation and persistence behavior'
            ]
            evidence=[
                'Repository search across the owning struct shows the frozen field(s) are either never read by UI/code or are non-reactive bookkeeping fields; no watcher, parent input, exported exposure, or lifecycle contract requires reactive ownership.',
                'All declarations, initializers, non-state reads, writes, and enclosing components were retained.'
            ]
            transformation='Removed only the @State decorator from the proven redundant field(s), retaining each original field declaration, type, initializer, and all surrounding component code as plain fields.'
        else:
            entity=f'immutable state field(s) in {base}'
            invariants=[
                'state ownership and reactive update sources',
                'UI reads and parent-child data flow',
                'lifecycle mutation and persisted/value semantics'
            ]
            if path.endswith('pageRoute.ets'):
                evidence=[
                    'angle is mutated by speedChange and read by Image.rotate, so its reactive ownership was preserved; imageSize is initialized once and only read by Image.scale.',
                    'The interval and state bookkeeping fields are handled by the redundant-state entity in the same component; no decorator or public declaration was deleted.'
                ]
                transformation='Kept angle as @State and made its existing timer mutation explicit as this.angle += this.speed; changed only the immutable imageSize field to a plain field while retaining its UI read and value.'
            else:
                evidence=[
                    'Repository-wide search of the owning struct found only the initializer and stable reads for the targeted field(s), with no assignments, compound mutations, watchers, parent inputs, lifecycle updates, or exported exposure.',
                    'Where rendered, the field is consumed by the existing Text/Image expression; declarations, initializers, literals, and component structure were preserved.'
                ]
                transformation='Removed only the @State decorator from the proven immutable field(s), retaining each original field declaration, type, initializer, literal, and all UI reads as plain fields.'
        repairs.append({
            'rule':rule,
            'relative_path':path,
            'locations':[{'line':x['line'],'column':x['column']} for x in f['locations']],
            'owning_entities':[entity],
            'invariants':invariants,
            'evidence':evidence,
            'transformation':transformation,
            'status':'repaired'
        })
report={
    'selected_rules':selected,
    'consulted_specs':consulted,
    'consulted_guides':{},
    'entity_repairs':repairs,
    'unresolved_external':[]
}
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2,ensure_ascii=True))
PY"
